title: Competence-Based Evaluation of Logical Reasoning in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.22894v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have brought impressive performance across diverse tasks; however, shortcomings remain in logical reasoning, including inconsistencies under linguistic variation. To improve the reasoning capacity of LLMs, we must be able to accurately measure their reasoning capacity. Current benchmarks primarily report single accuracy numbers on selected reasoning tasks. Such a performance-based evaluation methodology says little about a model's generalization capacity in reasoning. To address this limitation, we argue for a different evaluation paradigm, called competence-based evaluation (CBE), which tests whether models reliably apply the same competence across a family of problems. A parameterized generator scales complexity while keeping the required competence fixed, and matched answer-preserving presentations test correctness beyond one formulation. We instantiate CBE on elementary ordering tasks

translated_title: 基于能力的大语言模型逻辑推理评估
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）的最新进展使其在多种任务上展现出令人瞩目的性能；然而，在逻辑推理方面仍存在不足，包括在语言表述变化下的不一致性。为了提升大语言模型的推理能力，我们必须能够准确衡量其推理能力。当前的基准测试主要报告在选定推理任务上的单一准确率数字。这种基于性能的评估方法对于模型在推理方面的泛化能力说明甚少。为解决这一局限，我们主张采用一种不同的评估范式，称为基于能力的评估（CBE），它测试模型能否在一系列同族问题中可靠地运用相同的能力。参数化生成器在保持所需能力不变的情况下扩展问题复杂度，而匹配的、保留答案的多种表述方式则用于测试正确性是否超越单一表述形式。我们在基础的排序任务上实现了CBE。
tldr: 本文提出“基于能力的评估”（CBE）新范式，通过参数化生成器调节复杂度并使用保留答案的多种表述形式，来衡量大语言模型逻辑推理的泛化能力，而非仅依赖单一准确率指标。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Competence-Based Evaluation (CBE) paradigm that measures LLMs' logical reasoning generalization ability using a parameterized generator to scale complexity and matched answer-preserving presentations, moving beyond single accuracy metrics.
